articles.title_en: Estimation of common factors for microstructure noise and efficient price in a high-frequency dual factor model
articles.title_cn: 高频双因子模型中微观结构噪声与有效价格的共同因子估计
articles.abstract_en: We develop the Double Principal Component Analysis (DPCA) based on a dual factor structure for high-frequency intraday returns contaminated with microstructure noise. The dual factor structure allows a factor structure for microstructure noise in addition to the factor structure for efficient log-prices. We construct estimators of factors for both efficient log-prices and microstructure noise as well as their common components, and provide uniform consistency of these estimators when the number of assets and the sampling frequency go to infinity. In a Monte Carlo exercise, we compare our DPCA method to a PCA-VECM method. Finally, an empirical analysis of intraday returns of S&P 500 Index constituents provides evidence of co-movement of the microstructure noise that distinguishes from latent systematic risk factors.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们基于高频日内收益的双因子结构，开发了双主成分分析（DPCA），该收益受到微观结构噪声的污染。双因子结构允许微观结构噪声具有因子结构，此外有效对数价格也具有因子结构。我们构建了有效对数价格和微观结构噪声的因子估计量及其共同成分，并在资产数量和采样频率趋于无穷时提供了这些估计量的一致一致性。在蒙特卡洛实验中，我们将DPCA方法与PCA-VECM方法进行了比较。最后，对标准普尔500指数成分股日内收益的实证分析提供了微观结构噪声共同运动的证据，这区别于潜在的系统性风险因子。

articles.title_en: Robust estimation of integrated and spot volatility
articles.title_cn: 积分波动率与瞬时波动率的稳健估计
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a new method to estimate the integrated volatility (IV) and the spot volatility (SV) based on noisy high-frequency data. Our method employs the ReMeDI approach introduced by Li and Linton (2022) to estimate the moments of microstructure noise and thereby eliminate their influence, and the pre-averaging method to target the volatility parameter. The method is robust: it can be applied when the efficient price exhibits stochastic volatility and jumps, the observation times are random, and the noise process is nonstationary, autocorrelated, asymptotically vanishing and dependent on the efficient price. We derive the limit distributions for the proposed estimators under the infill asymptotics in a general setting. Our extensive simulation studies demonstrate the robustness, accuracy and computational efficiency of our estimators compared to several alternative estimators recently proposed in the literature. Empirically, we show that neglecting the complexities of noise and the random observation times generates substantial biases in volatility estimation and may yield a different intraday volatility pattern.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种基于含噪高频数据估计积分波动率（IV）和瞬时波动率（SV）的新方法。该方法采用Li和Linton（2022）提出的ReMeDI方法估计微观结构噪声的矩，从而消除其影响，并采用预平均方法针对波动率参数。该方法具有稳健性：当有效价格呈现随机波动率和跳跃、观测时间随机、噪声过程非平稳、自相关、渐近消失且依赖于有效价格时，均可适用。我们在一般设定下推导了所提估计量在填充渐近下的极限分布。我们广泛的模拟研究表明，与文献中近期提出的几种替代估计量相比，我们的估计量具有稳健性、准确性和计算效率。在实证中，我们表明忽略噪声的复杂性和随机观测时间会在波动率估计中产生显著偏差，并可能得出不同的日内波动率模式。

articles.title_en: Intraday volatility patterns from short-dated options
articles.title_cn: 短期期权中的日内波动率模式
articles.abstract_en: We propose a nonparametric estimator for the deterministic periodic component of volatility from short-dated options within an in-fill asymptotic setting. The estimator uses options with zero and one day to expiration sampled at high-frequency during a trading day. At each point in time, we aggregate the options to form nonparametric estimates of conditional risk-neutral expectations of future integrated return variation for the two available option tenors. A suitable ratio of these estimates removes the stochastic components of the conditional expectations of future volatility, up to asymptotically higher-order terms, and allows to form estimates of the deterministic periodic component of volatility. We derive a Central Limit Theorem for the estimator, with its rate of convergence determined from the mesh of the strike grid and the length of the time to expiration of the options. The newly-developed estimation procedure is applied to S&P 500 index options data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种在填充渐近框架下，利用短期期权估计波动率确定性周期成分的非参数估计器。该估计器使用交易日内高频采样的到期日为零天和一天的期权。在每个时间点，我们汇总期权，以形成对两种可用期权期限的未来积分收益变动的条件风险中性预期的非参数估计。这些估计的适当比率消除了未来波动率条件预期中的随机成分，直至渐近高阶项，并允许形成波动率确定性周期成分的估计。我们推导了该估计器的中心极限定理，其收敛速率由执行价格网格的间距和期权到期时间的长度决定。新开发的估计程序应用于S&P 500指数期权数据。

articles.title_en: Robust realized integrated beta estimator with application to dynamic analysis of integrated beta
articles.title_cn: 稳健的实现综合贝塔估计器及其在综合贝塔动态分析中的应用
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we develop a robust non-parametric realized integrated beta estimator using high-frequency financial data contaminated by microstructure noise, which is robust to the stylized features, such as the time-varying beta and the price-dependent and autocorrelated microstructure noise. With this robust realized integrated beta estimator, we investigate dynamic structures of integrated betas and find a persistent autoregressive structure. To model this dynamic structure, we utilize the autoregressive–moving-average (ARMA) model for daily integrated market betas. We call this the dynamic realized beta (DR Beta). Then, we propose a quasi-likelihood procedure for estimating the parameters of the ARMA model with the robust realized integrated beta estimator as the proxy. We establish asymptotic theorems for the proposed estimator and conduct a simulation study to check the performance of finite samples of the estimator. The proposed DR Beta model with the robust realized beta estimator is also illustrated by using data from the E-mini S&P 500 index futures and the top 50 large trading volume stocks from the S&P 500 and an application to constructing market-neutral portfolios.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们开发了一种稳健的非参数实现综合贝塔估计器，使用受微观结构噪声污染的高频金融数据，该估计器对诸如时变贝塔和价格依赖及自相关的微观结构噪声等典型特征具有稳健性。利用这一稳健的实现综合贝塔估计器，我们研究了综合贝塔的动态结构，并发现了一种持久的自回归结构。为了建模这一动态结构，我们利用自回归移动平均（ARMA）模型对日度综合市场贝塔进行建模，称之为动态实现贝塔（DR Beta）。然后，我们提出了一种拟似然程序，以稳健的实现综合贝塔估计器作为代理来估计ARMA模型的参数。我们为所提出的估计器建立了渐近定理，并进行了模拟研究以检验估计器在有限样本下的表现。所提出的DR Beta模型与稳健的实现贝塔估计器还通过使用E-mini S&P 500指数期货和S&P 500中交易量最大的前50只股票的数据以及构建市场中性投资组合的应用进行了说明。

articles.title_en: High dimensional regression coefficient test with high frequency data
articles.title_cn: 高频数据的高维回归系数检验
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents the first study on high-dimensional regression coefficient tests with high-frequency financial data. These tests allow the number of regressors to be larger than the number of observations within each estimation block and can grow to infinity in asymptotics. In this paper, the sum-type test and max-type test have been proposed, where the former is suitable for the dense alternative (many small betas) and the latter is suitable for the sparse alternative (a very small number of large betas). By showing the asymptotic independence between the sum-type test and max-type test, the paper proposes a third test – Fisher’s combination test, which is robust to both dense and sparse alternatives. The paper derives the limiting null distributions of the three proposed tests and analyzes the asymptotic behavior of their powers. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the validity of the theoretical results developed in this paper. Empirical study shows the impact of high frequency (HF) factors when being added to a Fama–French-style factor model. We found that the HF effects are time varying. The proposed tests can help identify those time periods when the HF factors carry (significant) incremental information for the test asset. Our tests could shed light on market timing in a trading strategy.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次提出了利用高频金融数据进行高维回归系数检验的研究。这些测试允许回归量的数量大于每个估计块内的观测值的数量，并且可以渐进地增长到无穷大。本文提出了sum-type test和max-type test，前者适用于密集替代（许多小贝塔），后者适用于稀疏替代（极少数大贝塔）。通过展示求和型检验和最大型检验之间的渐近独立性，本文提出了第三种检验——Fisher 组合检验，该检验对于密集和稀疏替代方案都具有鲁棒性。本文推导了所提出的三个检验的极限零分布，并分析了它们幂的渐近行为。蒙特卡洛模拟证明了本文理论结果的有效性。实证研究显示了高频 (HF) 因素添加到 Fama-French 式因素模型中时的影响。我们发现高频效应是随时间变化的。所提出的测试可以帮助识别 HF 因子携带测试资产（重要）增量信息的时间段。我们的测试可以揭示交易策略中的市场时机。

articles.abstract_en: Drift and volatility are two mainsprings of asset price dynamics. While volatilities have been studied extensively in the literature, drifts are commonly believed to be impossible to estimate and largely ignored in the literature. This paper shows how to detect drift using realized autocovariance implemented on high-frequency data. We use a theoretical treatment in which the classical model for the efficient price, an Itō semimartingale possibly contaminated by microstructure noise, is enriched with drift and volatility explosions. Our theory advocates a novel decomposition for realized variance into a drift and a volatility component, which leads to significant improvements in volatility forecasting.
articles.abstract_cn: 漂移和波动性是资产价格动态的两个主要驱动力。尽管波动性在文献中已被广泛研究，但漂移通常被认为无法估计，并在文献中很大程度上被忽视。本文展示了如何利用高频数据上的已实现自协方差来检测漂移。我们采用理论处理方法，其中有效价格的经典模型——一个可能受微观结构噪声污染的伊藤半鞅——被赋予了漂移和波动性爆发。我们的理论倡导一种新的分解方法，将已实现方差分解为漂移和波动性成分，这导致了波动性预测的显著改进。

articles.abstract_en: We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for an (Unbiased) Block estimator to have Uniformly Minimum Variance. Our theory parallels the theory of UMVU estimation, the main novel insight being the focus on the covariance among blocks. We use this theory to derive lower variance bounds for block estimators of functionals of high-frequency volatility when the block size is fixed. We further show the relevance of the new theory for the classical problem of estimation of homoskedastic nonparametric regressions with varying mean. Finally, we introduce a new test for the presence of drift in financial data which exploits the precision of BUMVU estimators. The test shows abundant presence of drift in financial data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了（无偏）块估计量具有一致最小方差性的充分必要条件。我们的理论与UMVU估计理论相平行，主要的新见解在于关注块间的协方差。我们利用这一理论推导了当块大小固定时，高频波动率泛函的块估计量的较低方差界。我们进一步展示了新理论对于具有变化均值的同方差非参数回归经典估计问题的相关性。最后，我们引入了一种新的检验方法，用于检测金融数据中漂移的存在，该方法利用了BUMVU估计量的精确性。该检验显示金融数据中漂移现象普遍存在。

articles.title_en: Probability distributions for realized covariance measures
articles.title_cn: 已实现协方差测度的概率分布
articles.abstract_en: Realized covariance measures (RCs) are an essential input for assessing the risks of different investment allocations. Thus, it is useful to model and forecast them. To this end, a realistic distributional assumption is needed. In this paper, we compare all probability distributions that have so far in the literature been applied to time-series of RCs. We derive them in a unified framework based on their stochastic representations using random lower and upper triangular matrices. These matrices are composed of standard normal distributions in the off-diagonal elements and χ-distributions on the diagonals (Barlett matrices). Furthermore, we derive a novel family of probability distributions (the t-Riesz distribution family), which has a property we call tail-homogeneity. This property means that in crisis periods, i.e. large RCs, our distribution family realistically assumes high dependence between the individual entries of the RCs. We show theoretically how all the distributions differ from each other, and how they are related to each other. In the empirical part, we demonstrate how the theoretical differences translate into differences in fit and forecasting performance. We show that our novel distribution family achieves the best fit. Out-of-sample forecasting comparisons further corroborate the excellent performance of our novel distribution family.
articles.abstract_cn: 已实现协方差测度（RCs）是评估不同投资配置风险的重要输入。因此，对它们进行建模和预测是有用的。为此，需要一个现实的分布假设。在本文中，我们比较了迄今为止文献中应用于RCs时间序列的所有概率分布。我们基于它们的随机表示，在一个统一框架中推导出这些分布，使用随机下三角和上三角矩阵。这些矩阵由非对角线元素的标准正态分布和对角线上的χ分布组成（巴特利特矩阵）。此外，我们推导了一个新的概率分布族（t-Riesz分布族），它具有我们称之为尾部同质性的性质。这个性质意味着在危机时期，即大的RCs，我们的分布族现实地假设RCs各个条目之间存在高依赖性。我们从理论上展示了所有分布之间的差异以及它们之间的相互关系。在实证部分，我们展示了理论差异如何转化为拟合和预测性能的差异。我们表明，我们的新分布族实现了最佳拟合。样本外预测比较进一步证实了我们新分布族的优异性能。

articles.abstract_en: We propose a novel class of multivariate GARCH models that incorporate realized measures of volatility and correlations. The key innovation is an unconstrained vector parametrization of the conditional correlation matrix, which enables the use of factor models for correlations. This approach elegantly addresses the main challenge faced by multivariate GARCH models in high-dimensional settings. As an illustration, we explore block correlation matrices that naturally simplify to linear factor models for the conditional correlations. The model is applied to the returns of nine assets, and its in-sample and out-of-sample performance compares favorably against several popular benchmarks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一类新颖的多元GARCH模型，该模型融入了波动率和相关性的已实现度量。关键创新在于对条件相关矩阵采用无约束向量参数化，这使得能够使用因子模型来刻画相关性。这种方法优雅地解决了多元GARCH模型在高维设置中所面临的主要挑战。作为示例，我们探讨了块相关矩阵，其自然简化为条件相关性的线性因子模型。该模型应用于九种资产的收益，其样本内和样本外表现优于几种流行的基准模型。

articles.title_en: Bespoke realized volatility: Tailored measures of risk for volatility prediction
articles.title_cn: 定制已实现波动率：针对波动率预测的定制风险度量
articles.abstract_en: Standard realized volatility (RV) measures estimate the latent volatility of an asset price using high frequency data with no reference to how or where the estimate will subsequently be used. This paper presents methods for “tailoring” the estimate of volatility to the application in which it will be used. For example, if the volatility measure will be used in a specific parametric forecasting model, it may be possible to exploit that knowledge to construct a better measure of volatility. We use methods from machine learning to estimate optimal “bespoke” RVs for heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) and GARCH-X forecasting applications. We apply the methods to 886 U.S. stock returns and find that bespoke RVs significantly improve out-of-sample forecast performance. We find that, across a variety of volatility models, the bespoke RV places more weight on data from the end of the trade day, and that the optimal bespoke weights can be well-approximated by a simple parametric function.
articles.abstract_cn: 标准的已实现波动率（RV）度量使用高频数据估计资产价格的潜在波动率，而不考虑该估计随后将如何或在哪里使用。本文提出了针对其将被用于的应用场景“定制”波动率估计的方法。例如，如果波动率度量将用于特定的参数预测模型，那么利用这一知识来构建更好的波动率度量可能是可行的。我们使用机器学习方法为异质自回归（HAR）和GARCH-X预测应用估计最优的“定制”RV。我们将这些方法应用于886只美国股票收益，并发现定制RV显著提高了样本外预测性能。我们发现，在各种波动率模型中，定制RV对交易日结束时的数据赋予了更大的权重，并且最优定制权重可以很好地通过一个简单的参数函数来近似。

articles.title_en: Efficient sampling for realized variance estimation in time-changed diffusion models
articles.title_cn: 时间变换扩散模型中实现方差估计的高效抽样
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyzes the benefits of sampling intraday returns in intrinsic time for the realized variance (RV) estimator. We theoretically show in finite samples that depending on the permitted sampling information, the RV estimator is most efficient under either hitting time sampling that samples whenever the price changes by a pre-determined threshold, or under the new concept of realized business time that samples according to a combination of observed trades and estimated tick variance. The analysis builds on the assumption that asset prices follow a diffusion that is time-changed with a jump process that separately models the transaction times. This provides a flexible model that allows for leverage specifications and Hawkes-type jump processes and separately captures the empirically varying trading intensity and tick variance processes, which are particularly relevant for disentangling the driving forces of the sampling schemes. Extensive simulations confirm our theoretical results and show that for low levels of noise, hitting time sampling remains superior while for increasing noise levels, realized business time becomes the empirically most efficient sampling scheme. An application to stock data provides empirical evidence for the benefits of using these intrinsic sampling schemes to construct more efficient RV estimators as well as for an improved forecast performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了在内在时间中对日内收益进行抽样对实现方差（RV）估计器的益处。我们在理论上证明，在有限样本中，根据允许的抽样信息，RV估计器在以下两种情况下最为有效：一是当价格变动达到预定阈值时进行抽样的击中时间抽样，二是根据观测交易和估计的跳动方差组合进行抽样的新概念——实现业务时间。该分析基于资产价格遵循一个由跳跃过程进行时间变换的扩散过程，该跳跃过程分别对交易时间进行建模。这提供了一个灵活的模型，允许杠杆设定和霍克斯型跳跃过程，并分别捕捉经验上变化的交易强度和跳动方差过程，这对于区分抽样方案的驱动因素尤为重要。大量模拟证实了我们的理论结果，并表明在低噪声水平下，击中时间抽样仍然优越，而在噪声水平增加时，实现业务时间成为经验上最有效的抽样方案。对股票数据的应用提供了经验证据，表明使用这些内在抽样方案构建更有效的RV估计器以及改善预测性能的益处。

articles.abstract_en: We develop and empirically examine a novel intraday invariance relation among trading activity variables across a set of currencies in the foreign exchange (FX) futures market exploiting tick level data. Our Trading Invariance (TI) hypothesis reflects an equilibrium involving trade-offs between the risk per trade versus market liquidity as captured by the bid-ask spread and market depth. We observe exogenous breaks in the trading costs for many of the currencies, as the exchange lowered the tick size for individual contracts at different points in time. Using these incidents as quasi-natural experiments, we confirm that the remaining components of the TI hypothesis adjust to maintain the equilibrium by shifts in the trading intensity and market depth. In contrast, alternative invariance relations fail dramatically when confronted with this type of exogenous shock. We further confirm that the values of key coefficients in the TI relation are similar across assets and in good correspondence with the theoretically predicted values. Our results point towards a fundamental equilibrium mechanism that should be accommodated within existing market microstructure paradigms. Moreover, they have direct implications for market design and surveillance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用逐笔数据，对外汇（FX）期货市场中一组货币的交易活动变量之间的一种新颖的日内不变性关系进行了发展和实证检验。我们的交易不变性（TI）假说反映了一种均衡，涉及每笔交易的风险与市场流动性（以买卖价差和市场深度衡量）之间的权衡。我们观察到许多货币的交易成本存在外生断裂，因为交易所不同时间点降低了单个合约的跳动点大小。利用这些事件作为准自然实验，我们确认TI假说的其余组成部分通过交易强度和市场深度的变化来调整以维持均衡。相比之下，替代性不变性关系在面对这种外生冲击时则彻底失效。我们进一步确认，TI关系中关键系数的值在不同资产间相似，并与理论预测值良好对应。我们的结果指向一种基本的均衡机制，该机制应被纳入现有的市场微观结构范式中。此外，它们对市场设计和监管具有直接意义。

articles.title_en: Reprint of: Nonparametric estimation for high-frequency data incorporating trading information
articles.title_cn: 重印：结合交易信息的高频数据非参数估计
articles.abstract_en: We propose nonparametric estimators for the explicative part of the noise in a model where the market microstructure noise is an unknown function of the trading information while allowing for the presence of an additional residual noise component. Our method allows for dependence in the observable trading information and accommodates the presence of infinite variation jumps in the efficient price process. We establish the convergence and asymptotic normality of the proposed estimators. We also propose a two-step Laplace estimator of integrated volatility where we replace the observed price with the estimated price by removing the explicative part of the market microstructure noise. The finite sample properties of both the nonparametric estimators and the two-step Laplace estimator are examined through Monte Carlo simulations. We find that our method is robust to misspecification of the unknown functional form given finite sample size. Furthermore, an empirical application using high-frequency data demonstrates that our method outperforms commonly employed parametric methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了非参数估计量，用于模型中噪声的解释部分，其中市场微观结构噪声是交易信息的未知函数，同时允许存在额外的残余噪声成分。我们的方法允许可观测交易信息中的依赖性，并适应有效价格过程中无限变差跳跃的存在。我们建立了所提出估计量的收敛性和渐近正态性。我们还提出了一种两步拉普拉斯积分波动率估计量，其中我们用估计价格替换观测价格，通过去除市场微观结构噪声的解释部分。通过蒙特卡洛模拟检验了非参数估计量和两步拉普拉斯估计量的有限样本性质。我们发现，在有限样本量下，我们的方法对未知函数形式的错误设定具有稳健性。此外，使用高频数据的实证应用表明，我们的方法优于常用的参数方法。

articles.title_en: Testing for jumps in a discretely observed price process with endogenous sampling times
articles.title_cn: 离散观测价格过程中内生抽样时间下的跳跃检验
articles.abstract_en: This paper introduces a novel nonparametric high-frequency jump test for discretely observed Itô semimartingales. Based on observations sampled recursively at first exit times from a symmetric double barrier, our method distinguishes between threshold exceedances caused by the Brownian component and jumps, which enables the construction of a feasible, noise-robust statistical test. Simulation results demonstrate superior finite-sample performance of our test compared to existing methods. An empirical analysis of NYSE-traded stocks provides clear statistical evidence for jumps, with the results highly robust to spurious detections.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文针对离散观测的Itô半鞅引入了一种新颖的非参数高频跳跃检验。基于在对称双障碍的首次退出时间递归抽样的观测值，我们的方法区分由布朗成分引起的阈值超越和跳跃，从而能够构建一个可行且对噪声稳健的统计检验。模拟结果表明，与现有方法相比，我们的检验具有优越的有限样本性能。对纽交所上市股票的实证分析提供了跳跃的明确统计证据，且结果对虚假检测高度稳健。
